sentence: Split shaft collar for 8 mm with an M4 cap screw: counterbore one side, tapped the other
design_notes: Ring 24 x 8 x 10.2 with a 1 mm split in C45 steel (10 thick left exactly 1 mm above and below the 8 mm counterbore, which an outward-rounded wall bound cannot decide against >= 1); screw axis along y at x = 8, z = 5.1: counterbore 8 dia to y = -4.5 (DIN 974-1 for ISO 4762 M4), clearance 4.5, tap drill 3.3 with an M4 6H callout; an ISO 4762 M4 x 10 screw (a catalog part, bought) seated on the counterbore floor with its tip at y = 5.5, inside the 0.5-7 thread (an M4 x 12 reaches y = 7.5 and jams in the untapped drill past the thread, which fasten reports as interference).
